=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:105-180 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No committed test runs the new fail-closed gate logic in `check_all_steps`: the `dv_last_rc` bookkeeping, the recheck gate at line 140, and the block at lines 172-178 that sets `DEEP_PASS=false` when the jobs listing cannot be read.
  WHY: A later edit to the `dv_last_rc` bookkeeping could quietly bring back the false "spurious re-trigger" pass, or start failing real spurious re-triggers, and CI would not catch it. The routing test only scans text, and the editor checked the new paths with a stub that is not committed. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3093-3110 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The per-read wait cap in `cleanup_gh_api_read()` (`time_left / 8`, recomputed on each call, up to two waits per read) can use up most of the cleanup window across the cleanup's 11-12 reads. In the worst case only about `0.75^12 ≈ 3.2%` (≈38 s) of the 20-minute reserve is left, and the comment above the function understates this.
  WHY: If the gate stays rate-limited, the job can time out before the cleanup writes run (cancellation POSTs, PR close, branch delete, issue close), leaving orphaned test artifacts. Severity disagrees: gemini said MAJOR (confidence 3), minimax said NIT (confidence 4), and the highest is used here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected the premise: a primary wait runs to the reset and the bucket refreshes, so waits cannot stack across reads.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:108-124, 154-160 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The outer retry loop and the indexing-delay recheck stop only on rc 75. A permanent failure (rc 2, e.g. HTTP 404 for a deleted run) or a non-rate-limit rc 3 is retried pointlessly before the fail-closed block fires.
  WHY: For runs that no longer resolve, about 18 s of job budget is burned before failing closed. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers," including the five `scripts/stable_e2e_step_*.sh` files (issue #10225, change 1); a read should wait for the rate-limit reset instead of exhausting fixed retries.
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (review-run polling reads; lines 345, 365, 382, 642, 645, 707, 730, 807, 934, 961, 981, 985, 1105)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR does not touch scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh. Its reads (lines 642-646 and the others listed) still call `gh_api_safe_quiet_print` from scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh (line 316). That helper uses fixed 30/60/120-second backoff and never waits for the reported reset (`scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:134-147`, lines 85, 139-145). The new routing test's _GH_CALL/_SAFE_GH_JQ_CALL patterns cannot see `gh_api_safe_quiet_print` calls, so this file passes without routing or an allowlist entry.
- requirement: "Bound each wait by the step's remaining budget... Where a step's budget is too small to cover a reset, raise the step limit rather than shorten the wait" (issue #10225, change 2).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml — "Phase 4d: Review-timeout run inventory" step (lines 2079-2083, reads at lines 2114 `TIMEOUT_INV_RUNS` and 2130 `TIMEOUT_INV_JOBS`, `timeout-minutes: 3`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both reads are still single-attempt `_safe_gh_jq` calls with no reset wait, and `timeout-minutes: 3` at line 2083 is unchanged. The PR instead adds allowlist entries for both sites in tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py (lines ~110-119, :115, :121), with reasons such as "a reset wait cannot fit". The editor recorded this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, but the issue text contains no such deferral. Because the step is continue-on-error, a failed read skips the inventory without failing the gate.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:check_all_steps, lines 107-178 (recheck gate line 140; fail-closed block lines 172-178) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new gate verdicts are untested: rc 75 gives up, skips the recheck and fails closed; rc 1 or 2 on the last recheck fails closed; rc 0 with zero jobs is still a spurious pass. The routing test only scans for raw reads, and the editor's stub is not in the repo.
  WHY: A later edit to `dv_last_rc` (e.g. dropping the assignment at line 151) could quietly bring back the false pass, or start failing real spurious re-triggers, and CI would not catch it.
- Note: Did not confirm the pass-1 `cleanup_gh_api_read` cap finding (.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 3100-3107). A primary wait in `gh_api_retry` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 2946-2965) sleeps to the reset, so at most one reset wait can happen per cleanup. A 60 s secondary wait fits under the 150 s cap.
- Note: TASK COMPLETENESS reported NONE. The Phase 4d `_safe_gh_jq` reads (lines 2114, 2130) are a sanctioned allowlist exception under change 5. scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh / `gh_api_safe_quiet_print` was never in the raw-read scope (the issue's evidence table shows 1 raw read, 0 helper reads), and the issue puts helper-behaviour changes out of scope.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml "Cleanup test artifacts", fallback `gh_api_retry() { gh api "$@"; }` (line 3092) with `EXISTING_PR_BODY=...` (line 3115). On failure the fallback writes the API error JSON to stdout, and that text ends up in the PR body PATCH. Fix: capture the output and print it only on success, in both cleanup steps (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh check_all_steps outer loop, lines 118-121, and the recheck gate at line 140. rc 2 (permanent failure) still costs 3 outer rounds plus 3 recheck reads (about 12 s). Fix: break on rc 2 and skip the recheck when `dv_last_rc` is 2 (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:cleanup_gh_api_read() function definition, lines 3100-3107 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-read wait cap does not leave enough time for cleanup writes, because each read can use up to two waits of one-eighth of the remaining job time.
  WHY: Across 11 reads, the job can time out before the cleanup writes (cancellation requests, artifact closing, branch deletion) finish, leaving orphaned test artifacts.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:check_all_steps() function, lines 105-178 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new fail-closed handling for an unreadable jobs listing has no unit test.
  WHY: DEEP_PASS=false and the failure diagnostic are not verified by any test, so a later change to the bookkeeping could regress them.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: Route the gate's reads through reset-aware helpers so a read waits for the rate-limit reset instead of exhausting fixed retries.
  Expected change site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh
  Evidence of absence: The polling reads are unchanged and still call `gh_api_safe_quiet_print`, which bypasses the reset-aware helper and relies on fixed retries.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: When a step's budget is too small to cover a reset wait, raise the step limit rather than omit or shorten the wait.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 4d review-timeout run inventory
  Evidence of absence: The reads at lines 2114 and 2130 are still single-attempt `_safe_gh_jq` calls, and the 3-minute timeout at line 2083 is unchanged. The routing test allowlists both calls instead.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:167-180 (fail-closed block `if [ "$TOTAL_JOBS" -eq 0 ] && [ "${dv_last_rc}" -ne 0 ]; then DEEP_PASS=false ...`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new fail-closed path changes what the release gate decides, and no test covers it. tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py only checks routing, and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_cleanup_cancels_dispatch_review.py and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_smoke_pr_cleanup.py do not run `check_all_steps`.
  WHY: Reordering the `dv_last_rc` assignment, or letting the recheck overwrite it to 0 after a 75, would quietly restore the false pass. A regression the other way would fail real spurious re-triggers. Neither direction has a regression test.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3100-3110 (`cleanup_gh_api_read()` body; comment at 3093-3099) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment says "all of them together never use it up before the writes", but with `time_left / 8` per wait and 3 attempts, N reads can use `1 - (3/4)^N` of the time left. After 12 reads that leaves about 3.2% (about 38 s) of the 20-minute reserve. There is no test for the cap: `test_smoke_cleanup_cancels_a_caller_run_past_page_one` sets `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1`.
  WHY: Under sustained rate limiting, the cancellation POST loop and the close-PR / branch-delete / close-issue writes can take longer than the ~38 s left, and the job is killed before they finish.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh:108-124 (outer loop), 154-160 (recheck loop) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only rc 75 short-circuits. rc 2 (HTTP 404) or a non-rate-limit rc 3 still falls through to `sleep 2` and is retried, even though a 404 can never succeed on retry.
  WHY: Deleted or expired runs burn about 18 s of job budget before the fail-closed block fires. Breaking on rc 2 in both loops would avoid this.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Bound each wait by the step's remaining budget, the way #10201 did for the dispatch (`DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS`)... Where a step's budget is too small to cover a reset, raise the step limit rather than shorten the wait" (issue #10225, change 2)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, the `Phase 4d: Review-timeout run inventory` step (around lines 2083-2200; reads at ~2114 `TIMEOUT_INV_RUNS="$(...)"` and ~2130 `TIMEOUT_INV_JOBS="$(...)"`) and its `timeout-minutes: 3`
  Evidence of absence: Both reads still call `_safe_gh_jq`, a single attempt with no reset wait, and `timeout-minutes: 3` is unchanged. Allowlist entries were added instead (`tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py` lines ~110-119). The editor flagged this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED.
- HARDENING: scripts/stable_e2e_step_deep_verify.sh (lines 108-124, 154-160). Mirror the rc 75 break for rc 2 in both loops, and gate the recheck with `&& [ "${dv_last_rc}" -ne 2 ]` (~6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING: agents.d/10225-gate-rate-limit-helpers.md (paragraph 2). The phrase "all of them together never use it up before the writes" is misleading. Replace it with the precise `(3/4)^12 ≈ 3%` bound (~2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
